raterID.Description: ID for each rater recruited on Prolific.

drawingID.Description: ID of the co-drawn drawing comprised of dyadID, drawingN, and session.

dyadID.Description: ID number of dyad that drew the drawing. Same generation dyads are in range 1001-1030 and intergenerational dyads are in range 2001-2031.

pID1.Description: Participant ID of one dyad member, who drew the drawing. Younger adults were assigned IDs in ranges 101-146 or 201-245 and older adults were assigned IDs in range 301-331.

pID2.Description: Participant ID of second dyad member, who drew the drawing.Younger adults were assigned IDs in ranges 101-146 or 201-245 and older adults were assigned IDs in range 301-331.

drawingN.Description: Number of drawing, 1 indicates first drawing, 2 indicates second drawing in a session.

elements.Description: Subjective rating of harmony between elements in the drawing, rated using a sliding scale.
elements.ItemWording: Elements of figures in the drawing

space.Description: Subjective rating of the use of space in the drawing, rated using a sliding scale.
space.ItemWording: Use of space in the drawing

style.Description: Subjective rating of the style of the drawing, rated using a sliding scale.
